## Requested change

Describe the owner's request and expected behavior.

## Scope

- [ ] Only files needed for the requested task changed.
- [ ] Protected/core changes were explicitly authorized by the owner.
- [ ] No credentials, fabricated results, skipped checks or unrelated refactors.

## Verification

List tests and actual results. For UI changes, attach desktop/mobile evidence.

## Release and rollback

Identify risk and how to revert this PR. Owner approval is required before merge/deploy.
